title: Correction Remediation Autopilot Queue
public_repo_rule: Public GitHub Pages may request previews and safe metadata receipts, but source mutation, raw prompts, document text and secrets stay behind protected backend auth.

backend_route.purpose: Preview or run a safe correction remediation queue that chains non-destructive metadata-only steps and stops at manual source mutation gates.

manual_stop.reason: Autopilot records only safe metadata receipts; source changes require explicit backend-only confirmation.

scenarios.expected: Loading correction review items starts a browser-safe autopilot preview without storing raw prompt, response or document text.
Run safe queue sends confirm:true and run_safe_steps:true to the protected backend and stores only public-safe queue metadata.
The backend returns a manual stop before memory or knowledge source mutation can occur.
The public flow starts no paid route and never stores provider credentials, raw chat text or document text.

next.label: autopilot source-mutation handoff gates
next.why: After safe metadata steps are automatic, the next slice should make the required manual handoff for real source changes clearer, resumable and auditable.
